title: maDMP rules file
description: The format of one definitions/rules/<standard>/<version>.json file: a 'standard' declaration plus a recursive tree of DMP fields. Two orthogonal facts per field: '_cardinality' says how many values ('1' and '0..1' single, '1..n' and '0..n' list), '_type' says what each value is ('object' for structured entities, otherwise a scalar format). There is no 'list' type, list-ness is expressed by the cardinality alone. Six further coherence rules are not expressed here: only '_type: object' fields may declare child fields, every '_type: object' field must declare at least one, '_allowed_values'/'_suggested_values' may only appear on scalar fields, the two may never appear together on one field, '_chapter_description' may only appear on a top-level object field, and in the base standard (no 'extends') every field carries a '_description', the question a researcher reads. An extension may redeclare a parent without one, to reach its own fields.

standard.description: Identifier of the standard this file defines, snake_case (e.g. 'rda_dcs'), and the name of the directory this file sits in.

version.description: Version of this standard, X.Y.Z. Must equal the file's own name: definitions/rules/<standard>/<version>.json.

extends.description: Present in an extension, absent from the base standard: the base it extends, and every version of it the extension was written for.

name.description: The standard's name as a reader sees it, e.g. 'RDA DMP Common Standard v1.2 (maDMP)'.

references.description: Where the standard is documented, one link each.

description.description: Free-form notes about this file's scope and conventions.

dmp.description: The root of the field tree, every key is a top-level DMP field. At least one.

_cardinality.description: How many values: '1' exactly one, '0..1' at most one, '1..n' at least one, '0..n' any number. 'n' means the field holds a JSON array.

_type.description: What each value is: 'object' for a structured entity with child fields, at least one, otherwise the scalar's expected format.

_description.description: Human-facing description of the field, the question a researcher reads. Never empty.

_chapter_description.description: Description of the chapter a top-level object field opens, the only place it is valid.

_allowed_values.description: Closed vocabulary: a value outside this list is a violation of the standard. Never together with '_suggested_values' on the same field.

_suggested_values.description: Recommended vocabulary: a value outside this list is only worth a warning. Never together with '_allowed_values' on the same field.
